subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy buttermilk pancakes topped with a dollop of pale yellow yuzu cream, a spoonful of yuzu marmalade with fine shreds of peel, glossy yuzu syrup running down one side, and a twist of candied yuzu peel
hero_ko: 유자 크림(연노랑) + 유자청 건더기(껍질 채) + 유자청 시럽

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The top face of each pancake is griddle-browned in a soft, blotchy, uneven gradient — warm caramel brown (#B9793F) at the centre where it sat longest on the hot pan, fading through toasty golden (#CF9455) into light golden (#D9A76B) toward the rim, with a few slightly darker freckles and one paler patch where a bubble lifted the batter, the way real pancakes never brown evenly. The side wall of every pancake is the pale cream of the risen crumb (#F1DDB0): a soft, spongy band with a fine open crumb texture, tiny irregular air pockets catching the light, meeting the browned top in a soft blurred edge rather than a hard line. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: YUZU CREAM
toppings.text: One generous dollop of whipped cream folded with yuzu curd — a pale, soft yellow (#F5E7A8), lighter and more muted than lemon curd, with a faint marbling where the curd was not fully mixed in — sits slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake: soft rounded peaks, a spoon-dropped shape with gentle folds, a matte velvety surface, its lower edge relaxing into a soft skirt against the warm pancake.

toppings.label: YUZU MARMALADE
toppings.text: A spoonful of yuzu marmalade (yuja-cheong) rests on top of the cream and slides a little down its side: a glossy, translucent golden-amber jelly (#D9A431) packed with fine shreds of yuzu peel (#C9A22A) — thin, slightly curled strips of different lengths, some with a hint of green-yellow rind, tangled loosely rather than laid flat — with a few shreds escaping onto the browned pancake below. The marmalade catches bright soft highlights and looks sticky and fresh.

toppings.label: SYRUP
toppings.text: The thin syrup from the marmalade (#E3B84A), clear and glossy, has run off the spoonful over the front edge of the top pancake in two slow drips of different lengths down the pale side walls, turning the crumb it touches a darker soaked gold, with a small glossy pool forming where the top and middle pancakes meet.

toppings.label: FINISHING
toppings.text: One twist of candied yuzu peel (#D4B13A), a thin curled strip about 4 cm long with a slightly bumpy rind, balanced on the cream. A barely-there haze of powdered sugar over the far rim of the top pancake. One small sprig of fresh mint with two leaves (#3E7A45) tucked against the cream. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only. Appetizing food-photography color grading: warm, fresh, clean whites, saturated but natural colours, no colour cast on the background. notes_ko: v5(2026-09-02): 리서치(med) — 유자는 생과 슬라이스가 아니라 유자청/유자커드로 가공되어 올라감. 유자크림(레몬커드보다 연하고 탁한 노랑) + 유자청 건더기(껍질 채) + 시럽 + 캔디드 필. 유자≠레몬: 껍질이 울퉁불퉁하고 연두빛 섞임.
